conversion: Fixed declared Arrow types only; labels preserved, numeric empty fields remain null, no imputation/scaling/fitting. Added spatial_role from frozen cell selector. This is a dataset with labels/metadata, not an automatically approved predictor matrix.
final_test_policy: Final-test file is isolated and set read-only after writing. No target distributions or predictive scores computed. Earlier 2019 EDA exposure remains disclosed. Hashes verify content but do not prevent future improper access.
spatial_policy: For the separate spatial experiment, select only spatial_development during fitting and spatial_test in 2019 for final scoring; exclude buffer_excluded and all fire_history_* predictors.
training_enforcement: No fitted model/training entry point has been created; consumers must explicitly apply the stated roles and predictor exclusions.
